gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-kosugi-maru: Kosugi Maru reads like glowing tubing, every stroke the same line thickness with the ends set well apart. Comic Relief is the louder partner, its bowls left unfinished on one side, and it makes a rounded body feel friendly by comparison.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-kumbh-sans: Kumbh Sans reads cleanly, its terminals cut well short of the bowl as if drawn with a fixed pen. Kumbh Sans then gives Comic Relief's open-sided bowls and bold, commanding display letters a tidy line of text to stand over.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-libre-franklin: Libre Franklin reads crisp and businesslike, with a splayed c terminal. Comic Relief does the loud, commanding work in the big lines, while the sans-serif text underneath simply carries the information without competing for attention.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-livvic: Friendly meets forceful here. Comic Relief hits hard with its bold display letters, while Livvic does the quieter job, its curves free of stress and each c opening generously for easy, approachable text.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-lunasima: Loud on top, tidy below. Comic Relief gives each stroke the same visual weight with bowls left open on one side, and Lunasima sits next to it with c tips that never creep toward touching.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-lxgw-marker-gothi: LXGW Marker Gothic reads neutral and modern, with a wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart. And Comic Relief, shaped like a bent paperclip with no thick and thin shifts, sits above a body whose gentle stroke variation still feels related.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-m-plus-1: Contemporary is the mood, with a bold heading over a body of big open eyes. M PLUS 1 draws the flat line of a fineliner on paper, and that restraint is what holds up Comic Relief's commanding letters.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-m-plus-1p: Comic Relief lays down bold, rope-like strokes in its letter shapes, with bowls left unfinished on one side. And M PLUS 1p does the opposite job in text, keeping every curve end open so the sans stays clean.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-m-plus-2: Comic Relief hits with bold, commanding display letters whose bowls stay unfinished on one side. M PLUS 2 follows with a gaping c opening and one fixed nib width, approachable and professional, so the pair's strongest quality is its friendly punch.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-m-plus-code-latin: Approachable describes both, though one shouts. M PLUS Code Latin bends neon tubing into letters of constant thickness, each c with the wide mouth of a pitcher, and that openness is the pair's strongest quality beside Comic Relief.
